statements.text: This SOP governs the end-to-end IVIG home infusion process at CareIG Specialty Pharmacy — from referral receipt through claim payment.
statements.quote: This SOP governs the end-to-end IVIG home infusion process at CareIG Specialty Pharmacy — from referral receipt through claim payment.

statements.text: All staff performing intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical scheduling, or billing must follow this document.
statements.quote: All staff performing intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, clinical scheduling, or billing must follow this document.

statements.text: It references standard tools including spreadsheets, email, Slack, shared file storage, and calendar.
statements.quote: It references standard tools including spreadsheets, email, Slack, shared file storage, and calendar.

statements.text: No proprietary EHR, clearinghouse portal, or payer portal is required.
statements.quote: No proprietary EHR, clearinghouse portal, or payer portal is required.

statements.text: All case data lives under a case folder named CASE_ID (format: LastName_MMDDYYYY), where the date is the patient's DOB.
statements.quote: All case data lives under a case folder named CASE_ID (format: LastName_MMDDYYYY), where the date is the patient's DOB.

statements.text: This CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references throughout this SOP.
statements.quote: This CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references throughout this SOP.

statements.text: Team communications use defined Slack channels.
statements.quote: Team communications use defined Slack channels.

statements.text: Claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments.
statements.quote: Claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments.

statements.text: All major actions are logged to audit_log.xlsx.
statements.quote: All major actions are logged to audit_log.xlsx.

statements.text: For any date you write in files, use the YYYY-MM-DD format, except if specified otherwise.
statements.quote: For any date you write in files, use the YYYY-MM-DD format, except if specified otherwise.

statements.text: Covered drugs: Gammaplex, Octagam, Gammagard S/D, Gammagard Liquid, Privigen, Gamunex-C, Hizentra, HyQvia.
statements.quote: Covered drugs: Gammaplex, Octagam, Gammagard S/D, Gammagard Liquid, Privigen, Gamunex-C, Hizentra, HyQvia.

statements.text: If you encounter a situation not covered by this SOP, do not guess.
statements.quote: If you encounter a situation not covered by this SOP, do not guess.

statements.text: Stop work on that step, note what happened in audit_log.xlsx, and contact your direct supervisor immediately using the escalation path in Section 12.
statements.quote: Stop work on that step, note what happened in audit_log.xlsx, and contact your direct supervisor immediately using the escalation path in Section 12.

statements.text: When in doubt, always escalate before acting.
statements.quote: When in doubt, always escalate before acting.

statements.text: Audit Logging
statements.quote: Audit Logging

statements.text: Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint.
statements.quote: Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint.

statements.text: Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).
statements.quote: Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).

statements.text: Do not log every substep — only the checkpoints called out in each section.
statements.quote: Do not log every substep — only the checkpoints called out in each section.

statements.text: The Stop Protocol (Section 4.2) is itself a checkpoint — always log a stop event when triggered, even though it is not listed as a checkpoint within a specific workflow section.
statements.quote: The Stop Protocol (Section 4.2) is itself a checkpoint — always log a stop event when triggered, even though it is not listed as a checkpoint within a specific workflow section.

statements.text: Stop Protocol
statements.quote: Stop Protocol

statements.text: When a validation condition fails: note the reason in audit_log.xlsx with action 'Stop Protocol' and columns File_Updated, Field_Updated, and New_Value set to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved.
statements.quote: When a validation condition fails: note the reason in audit_log.xlsx with action 'Stop Protocol' and columns File_Updated, Field_Updated, and New_Value set to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved.

statements.text: Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.
statements.quote: Do not move to the next step until your supervisor or the responsible team member confirms the issue has been cleared.

statements.text: Prohibited Actions
statements.quote: Prohibited Actions

statements.text: Do not bill any IVIG drug J-code when clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG.
statements.quote: Do not bill any IVIG drug J-code when clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG.

statements.text: Do not bill pre-medication J-codes unless visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered documents drug, dose, route, time, and indication.
statements.quote: Do not bill pre-medication J-codes unless visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered documents drug, dose, route, time, and indication.

statements.text: Do not use ordered dose for unit calculations — always use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams.
statements.quote: Do not use ordered dose for unit calculations — always use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams.

statements.text: Do not submit a claim when claim.xlsx already has Submission_Date populated for the same DOS.
statements.quote: Do not submit a claim when claim.xlsx already has Submission_Date populated for the same DOS.

statements.text: Do not write off any balance >$200 without Director of Revenue Cycle approval (Slack #billing-mgmt).
statements.quote: Do not write off any balance >$200 without Director of Revenue Cycle approval (Slack #billing-mgmt).

statements.text: Do not respond to legal threats or attorney communications — post to #compliance immediately.
statements.quote: Do not respond to legal threats or attorney communications — post to #compliance immediately.

statements.text: Do not assign an ICD-10 code not supported by the physician's documentation and the PA approval.
statements.quote: Do not assign an ICD-10 code not supported by the physician's documentation and the PA approval.

statements.text: Phone Call Workaround
statements.quote: Phone Call Workaround

statements.text: When a step requires a phone call, check whether the required information has already been provided via email, referral document, or another input file.
statements.quote: When a step requires a phone call, check whether the required information has already been provided via email, referral document, or another input file.

statements.text: If the information is already available, proceed using that source and log the source in the relevant call log field, if appropriate.
statements.quote: If the information is already available, proceed using that source and log the source in the relevant call log field, if appropriate.

statements.text: If the information is not available and a call cannot be made, follow the Stop Protocol (Section 4.2).
statements.quote: If the information is not available and a call cannot be made, follow the Stop Protocol (Section 4.2).

statements.quote: Patient Contact

statements.text: Call patient at intake.xlsx col Patient_Phone. Verbatim script:

statements.text: "Hello, may I speak with [Patient Name]?
statements.quote: "Hello, may I speak with [Patient Name]?

statements.text: This is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy.
statements.quote: This is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy.

statements.text: Dr. [Physician_Name] has referred you for home IVIG infusion therapy.
statements.quote: Dr. [Physician_Name] has referred you for home IVIG infusion therapy.

statements.text: I'm calling to verify your information and explain next steps.
statements.quote: I'm calling to verify your information and explain next steps.

statements.text: Do you have a few minutes?"
statements.quote: Do you have a few minutes?"

statements.text: If no answer, leave this voicemail verbatim — do not state the diagnosis:
statements.quote: If no answer, leave this voicemail verbatim — do not state the diagnosis:

statements.text: "Hello, this is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy at [Phone].
statements.quote: "Hello, this is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy at [Phone].

statements.text: We received a referral from your physician.
statements.quote: We received a referral from your physician.

statements.text: Please call us back at your convenience.
statements.quote: Please call us back at your convenience.

statements.text: Thank you."
statements.quote: Thank you."

statements.text: When patient is reached: confirm demographics, explain the consent requirement, and email the consent form to intake.xlsx col Patient_Email. Set intake.xlsx col Consent_Status = Form Sent.

statements.text: Use the following rules:
statements.quote: Use the following rules:

statements.text: Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.
statements.quote: Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.

statements.text: Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.
statements.quote: Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.

statements.text: Saline | J7030 × NS_500mL_Bags_Used. J7050 × NS_250mL_Bags_Used. Both from visit_note.xlsx. For Gammaplex cases: do not bill J7030 or J7050. Instead bill A4221 for the Dextrose supply as part of the general infusion supplies line. Read Dextrose_500mL_Bags_Used from visit_note.xlsx to confirm administration was documented before billing.
statements.quote: Saline | J7030 × NS_500mL_Bags_Used. J7050 × NS_250mL_Bags_Used. Both from visit_note.xlsx. For Gammaplex cases: do not bill J7030 or J7050. Instead bill A4221 for the Dextrose supply as part of the general infusion supplies line. Read Dextrose_500mL_Bags_Used from visit_note.xlsx to confirm administration was documented before billing.

statements.text: Pre-Medications | Parse visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered. Diphenhydramine: J0171 × (mg ÷ 50). Promethazine: J2550 × (mg ÷ 25). If None administered: leave blank.

statements.text: Supplies | A4221 × 1 per visit. If Pump_Used = YES: also A4222 × 1.

rule.text: Drug J-Code | Look up J-code in jcodes.xlsx for Drug_Name_Trade. Units = (Dose_Administered_Grams × 1000) ÷ unit size. See Section 13 for full table and examples. If the result is not a whole number, round down to the nearest integer. Example: 25.3g Privigen = 50,600mg ÷ 500 = 101.2 → bill 101 units.

rule.text: Nursing Code | If Visit_Duration_Minutes is 60 or less, bill 99600 × 1 only. Do not bill 99603. Read benefits.xlsx col Nursing_Code_Pref. Blank or 99600: bill 99600 × 1 + 99603 × floor((Visit_Duration_Minutes − 60) ÷ 60). G0153 (Medicare Part B): bill G0153 × 1 only. T1029/T1032: verify per state in payer_rules.xlsx.

rule.text: CO-22 | COB — other payer may be primary | CO-22 means another payer is primary. Check benefits.xlsx col Secondary_Insurance. When their EOB is received, save it as era_[DOS]_[PrimaryPayer].pdf and resubmit to the original payer with COB fields populated: COB_Other_Payer_Name, COB_Other_Payer_Member_ID, COB_Other_Payer_Paid, COB_Other_Payer_EOB_Date.

Before making this call, calculate the patient's estimated out-of-pocket using benefits.xlsx.
Add together any remaining deductible (Deductible_Individual minus Deductible_Met_YTD), then apply the Coinsurance_Pct to the expected billed amount, and add the Copay_Amount if applicable.
